「Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars」is an Apple TV documentary series telling the story of chasing the highest honours in the culinary world, and it's making a strong comeback. Here are the details.

「Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars」makes a triumphant return

Less than a year since the first season of 「Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars」premiered, the show delivers a brand-new eight episodes, continuing to tell the stories of restaurants around the world as they pursue, maintain or add Michelin stars.

Hosted by food and travel expert Jesse Burgess, with Gordon Ramsay and Studio Ramsay Global serving as executive producers, the show documents the stories of restaurants, chefs and their teams, as well as the relentless efforts required to win and sustain the highest honours in the culinary world.

Apple announced a few days ago that the new season will feature 16 restaurants across Europe, the United States and Brazil, each at a different stage of pursuing stars.

Following the premiere of the first two episodes today, new episodes will be released every Friday, running through 6 November.
